products.imageAlt: Design visualization of a brass and dark wood sealing stamp with navy wax and ivory stationery
details: Materials & engraving
The intended design combines brass and wood with engraved ZELRÔC PRIVÉ artwork. Final wood species, head dimensions, engraving and finish are awaiting confirmation.
Presentation sets
Stamp-only, wax and stationery presentations are under consideration. These preview options do not confirm a set's contents or availability.
Use & care
Instructions, compatible wax and care guidance will be published with the finished product. This is a physical sealing tool, not a collectible postage stamp.
